description: This class defines a utility component for managing application configuration properties, providing methods to get and set properties, and a method to retrieve property values with logging if properties are not loaded.

classes.name: AppConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring component that manages application configuration properties, allowing retrieval and modification of properties with logging support.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the Properties object containing application configuration.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets the Properties object with application configuration.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property by key, logs a warning if properties are not loaded.
